notes.note: Voice introduces King Narendra on a hunt and his arrow striking the rishi. The one planned still opens on the aftermath (pot in the stream, bow lowered), so the hunt and the shot are never seen.
notes.fix: Add a still of the king drawing his bow among the trees, no target in frame, for the first two phrases; keep the aftermath still from 'ఋషి చనిపోయాడు'.

notes.note: One still (the king waist-deep, light in his hands) covers the search, the find and the installation. 'Then the bank in lamp light' has no asset.
notes.fix: Add a still of the lamp-lit bank: the king kneeling before a small lamp-lit shrine, seen from behind, no linga drawn; cut to it on 'ఒడ్డునే'.
